ai.title: Update gpt-5.2, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.4 pricing
ai.summary: Input, cached, and output token costs for gpt-5.2, gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-5.3-codex, and gpt-5.4 in web/src/llm-api/openai.ts. gpt-5.4 output cost rises to 15, while gpt-5.2 and gpt-5.3-codex shift to 14. Scope limited to core pricing constants; no CLI or UI logic changes. Cached input rates scale proportionally with base input costs.

eli5.text: The cost of running certain AI assistants just went up, so if your team or plan uses GPT-5.2, GPT-5.3 with code tools, or GPT-5.4, you will pay more for each response those assistants generate. Prices for using these assistants rose sharply, with GPT-5.4 now costing 50% more per reply and the others about 40% higher, while discounted cached input rates climbed in the same proportions. These pricing constants are already in place in the billing system, so the higher rates apply to usage from today.
